info.name: Github Runners API
Runners
GitHub List Self-hosted Runner Groups for an Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

params.name: visible_to_repository
params.description: Only return runner groups that are allowed to be used by this repository.

items.docs:
Lists all self-hosted runner groups configured in an organization and inherited from an enterprise.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

info.name: GitHub Create Self-hosted Runner Group for an Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs:
Creates a new self-hosted runner group for an organization.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

info.name: GitHub Add Repository Access to Self-hosted Runner Group in an Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: runner_group_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner group.

params.name: repository_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

items.docs:
Adds a repository to the list of repositories that can access a self-hosted runner group. The runner group must have `visibility` set to `selected`. For more information, see "[Create a self-hosted runner group for an organization](#create-a-self-hosted-runner-group-for-an-organization)."

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: runner_group_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner group.

params.name: repository_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

items.docs:
Removes a repository from the list of selected repositories that can access a self-hosted runner group. The runner group must have `visibility` set to `selected`. For more information, see "[Create a self-hosted runner group for an organization](#create-a-self-hosted-runner-group-for-an-organization)."

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.

items.docs:
Lists all self-hosted runners configured in an organization.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint. If the repository is private, the `repo` scope is also required.

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs:
Lists binaries for the runner application that you can download and run.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.  If the repository is private, the `repo` scope is also required.

items.docs:
Forces the removal of a self-hosted runner from an organization. You can use this endpoint to completely remove the runner when the machine you were using no longer exists.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the`admin:org` scope to use this endpoint. If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

self-hosted runner configured in an organization.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint. If the repository is private, the `repo` scope is also required.

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: runner_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner.

items.docs:
Remove all custom labels from a self-hosted runner configured in an
organization. Returns the remaining read-only labels from the runner.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint. If the repository is private, the `repo` scope is also required.

info.name: GitHub Remove Custom Label from Self-hosted Runner for an Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: runner_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of a self-hosted runner's custom label.

items.docs:
Remove a custom label from a self-hosted runner configured
in an organization. Returns the remaining labels from the runner.

This endpoint returns a `404 Not Found` status if the custom label is not
present on the runner.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint. If the repository is private, the `repo` scope is also required.
